abstract: Cis-diamminedichloroplatinum(II) (cis-DDP) and cis diamminediaquoplatinum(II) nitrate (cis-aq) were complexed to poly-L-glutamic acid (PG) of Mr 13,000 or 58,000. Soluble complexes were formed by mixing the platinum(II) compounds with the PG preparations in water at a molar ratio of one platinum(II) to 5 glutamyl residues of the PG. Compared to free cis-DDP, the complexes were about 2 to 6 times less cytotoxic to F9 embryonal carcinoma cells in vitro. In vivo studies with this tumor indicated that when administered i.p. one day after the tumor cells, the complexes were somewhat less active than cis-DDP. However, in comparison to the free drug which, due to its toxicity, was effective only within a very narrow dose range, the complexes were much less toxic, manifesting a wide therapeutic range in which no mortality occurred either from the tumor or as a result of the toxic effects of the drug. Cis-DDP and cis-aq complexes of PG Mr-58,000 were somewhat more toxic than the complexes of PG Mr, 13,000. The in vivo anti-tumor activity of most complexes was superior to that of free cis-DDP when tested in mice carrying high tumor loads. Due to their wide therapeutic range, the complexes could be given at high drug doses resulting in increased life span of the tumor-bearing mice. Moreover, 3 repeated injections of these high doses did not cause death from toxicity and resulted in partial or total eradication of advanced tumors.
abstract_ja: シス-ジアンミンジクロロ白金(II)(cis-DDP)およびシス-ジアンミンジアクオ白金(II)硝酸塩(cis-aq)を、分子量13,000または58,000のポリ-L-グルタミン酸(PG)と錯体形成させた。白金(II)化合物とPG製剤を水中で、白金1分子に対しPGのグルタミル残基5個のモル比で混合し、可溶性錯体を作製した。遊離のcis-DDPと比べ、錯体はF9胎児性癌細胞に対するin vitroの細胞傷害性が約2〜6分の1であった。in vivo試験では、腫瘍細胞投与の1日後に腹腔内投与した場合、錯体は遊離のcis-DDPよりやや活性が低かった。しかし、遊離薬は毒性のため有効な用量範囲が非常に狭かったのに対し、錯体は毒性がはるかに低く、腫瘍による死亡も毒性による死亡も生じない広い治療域を示した。cis-DDPおよびcis-aqの錯体では、PG分子量58,000由来の錯体が13,000由来の錯体よりやや毒性が強かった。高腫瘍量のマウスでは、ほとんどの錯体の抗腫瘍活性が遊離のcis-DDPより優れていた。治療域が広いため、錯体は高用量で投与することができ、担癌マウスの生存期間を延長させた。さらに、この高用量を3回反復投与しても毒性による死亡は起こらず、進行腫瘍の部分的または完全な消失をもたらした。
